Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.pasteur

Class PasteurCleanUpPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.pasteur.PasteurCleanUpPolicy
public class PasteurCleanUpPolicy extends Object
PasteurCleanUpPolicy decides which finished actions are old enough to be cleaned up. It is built from the daysToCleanUp and completionStatuses configuration properties and holds no connection to the open metadata ecosystem, so the rules can be tested on their own.

An action is eligible for clean-up when all of these are true:

  • its type, or the nearest of its supertypes, has an entry in daysToCleanUp;
  • its activity status is one of the completion statuses;
  • at least that many days have passed since it completed. The completion time is the action's completionTime property, or the time it was last updated (or created) if that is not set.

      public Long getDaysToCleanUp(String typeName, List<String> superTypeNames)

      typeName - name of the action's type
      superTypeNames - names of its supertypes, nearest first - may be null

    • getCompletionDate

      public static Date getCompletionDate(Date completionTime, Date updateTime, Date createTime)
      Return when the action completed. This is its completionTime property if it is set. Otherwise, it is the time the action was last updated, since setting the final status is normally the last update. An action that has never been updated uses its creation time.
      Parameters:
      completionTime - the action's completionTime property - may be null
      updateTime - when the action was last updated - may be null
      createTime - when the action was created - may be null
      Returns:
      date, or null if none of them is known

    • parseDaysToCleanUp

      public static Map<String,Long> parseDaysToCleanUp(Object configurationValue, List<String> invalidEntries)
      Turn the value of the daysToCleanUp configuration property into a map of type name to days. The values arrive as numbers (Integer or Long, depending on their size, when the connection is read from JSON) or as strings. The entries that can not be turned into a number of days that is zero or more are skipped and described in invalidEntries.
      Parameters:
      configurationValue - value of the configuration property - may be null
      invalidEntries - list to add descriptions of the skipped entries to
      Returns:
      map of type name to days - empty if the value is null or not a map

    • parseCompletionStatuses

      public static List<String> parseCompletionStatuses(List<String> configuredStatuses, List<String> defaultStatuses, List<String> invalidStatuses)
      Check the configured completion statuses against the ActivityStatus enum. The comparison ignores case and surrounding spaces. The statuses that are not recognized are skipped and added to invalidStatuses.
      Parameters:
      configuredStatuses - value of the completionStatuses configuration property - null means use the default
      defaultStatuses - statuses to use if none are configured
      invalidStatuses - list to add the unrecognized statuses to
      Returns:
      list of the symbolic names of the recognized statuses
